Bloomberg :

 Ukraine says its air raid alert app was compromised late Sunday, sending false warnings of “nuclear danger”; Russia confirms a similar hack of its alerts app   —  Ukraine and Russia said they faced cyberattacks on emergency and air raid alert systems.
